dedupe_keys.name: livorno municipal police road crash records 2002 2012

description: The Municipality of Livorno publishes road-crash records collected by its municipal police. Eleven annual datasets cover 2002 through 2012, within the source-defined road-crash series and its annual-data container. The description lists case number, year and date, location and street code, time, ages of participants and passengers, fatalities, injuries, minors, district, insurance, violations and vehicle types. These fields describe recorded road-transport incidents and their consequences. The provider explicitly says that the series covers incidents attended by municipal police, so it does not represent every crash in Livorno. Annual records and the two enclosing series entries are grouped together and are not counted as independent incident populations. The annual-data description states CSV; native metadata also lists archive distributions. RDF/XML links describe metadata. Related road-maintenance and physical-road resources cover other aspects of the municipal network. No traffic denominator, exposure model, causal estimate or particular simulation use is established. The source states CC BY-SA 2.0. Present completeness, field accuracy, access requirements and data-use charges were not tested. No crash rows or archive contents were downloaded.
